title: Evaluate spontaneous capture separately from reviewed reuse
body: Knowledge evaluations need a separate semantic review of the actual captured proposal before reuse. During the 2026-09-08 development trial, a structurally eligible proposal invented a standing owner-approval requirement from a temporary task restriction, so review rejected it. Other runs chose the right directory but could not create a worktree because of fixture permissions; they were failures, not successful reuse. Never seed a missed capture or rewrite a bad record to rescue an agent result. Preserve rejected proposals, failed tool/session outcomes and harness limitations separately from product behavior. Existing guidance and ordinary file notes also captured the lesson in a prototype comparison, so a completed candidate smoke test alone does not establish a Mason advantage. Keep a no-capture control and distinguish synthetic development evidence from held-out or real-project performance.
